text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Everyone was so amazing out there… I just knew there was no way I could catch up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why couldn't I match their determination? I'm so ashamed of myself… Argh!
choice_data_list: But you were still great out there.
Use this loss as a springboard to future success.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're right. I can't deny that I tried my best. I should at least acknowledge that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty… I can't forget how hard I've worked today. I'm gonna use that as inspiration to give it all I've got from tomorrow onwards!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Today's loss really hurts… And that's exactly why I can't let myself forget it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I really need to dive deep, analyzing why I lost and seeing what I did wrong.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then I can use the knowledge I gain to do better in my next race! I hope you'll help me out, Trainer!
